import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int R, C, TOTAL, idx;
    static char[] INPUT = new char[70];
    static long[][] COMB = new long[70][70];

    static int[] countA = new int[70];
    static int[] countB = new int[70];
    static ArrayList<Long>[] PARTIAL = new ArrayList[70];
    static ArrayList<Long>[] PARTIAL_ZERO = new ArrayList[70];

    static void precompute_comb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= TOTAL; ++i) {
            COMB[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                COMB[i][j] = COMB[i-1][j-1] + COMB[i-1][j];
        }
    }

    static long compute_delta(int pattern, int a_before, int b_before) {
        long result = 0;
        long temp1, temp2;

        for (int k = 0; k < C + 1; ++k) {
            if ((pattern & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                ++b_before;
                temp1 = COMB[b_before - 1][R - 1];
                temp2 = COMB[TOTAL - b_before][R] - COMB[a_before][R];
                result -= temp1 * temp2;
            } else {
                ++a_before;
                temp1 = COMB[a_before - 1][R - 1];
                temp2 = COMB[TOTAL - a_before][R] - COMB[b_before][R];
                result += temp1 * temp2;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static boolean is_valid_pattern(int pattern) {
        for (int k = 0; k < C + 1; ++k) {
            if (INPUT[2 * R + C + k] == 'A' && ((pattern >> k) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (INPUT[2 * R + C + k] == 'B' && ((pattern >> k) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void construct_tables() {
        int max_pattern = 1 << (C + 1);

        for (int pat = 0; pat < max_pattern; ++pat) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(pat);
            int a_here = C + 1 - b_here;

            if (is_valid_pattern(pat))
                PARTIAL[a_here].add(compute_delta(pat, R + C - a_here, R + C - b_here));
            else
                PARTIAL_ZERO[a_here].add(compute_delta(pat, R + C - a_here, R + C - b_here));
        }

        for (int k = 0; k <= C + 1; ++k) {
            Collections.sort(PARTIAL[k]);
            Collections.sort(PARTIAL_ZERO[k]);
        }
    }

    static long get_multiplier(int pattern) {
        int i, j;

        for (i = 0; i < C + 1; ++i)
            if (((pattern >> i) & 1) != (pattern & 1))
                break;

        for (j = i; j < C + 1; ++j) {
            if (INPUT[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'A' && (((pattern >> j) & 1) == 1)) return 0;
            if (INPUT[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'B' && (((pattern >> j) & 1) == 0)) return 0;
        }

        int set_a = R - 1 + ((pattern & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int set_b = R - 1 + ((pattern & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);

        if (set_a < countA[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < countB[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return COMB[set_a + set_b - countA[2 * R - 2 + i] - countB[2 * R - 2 + i]][set_a - countA[2 * R - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void update_optimal(long[] best, long[] candidate) {
        if (candidate[0] < 0) candidate[0] = -candidate[0];

        if (best[0] < candidate[0]) return;
        if (best[0] > candidate[0]) {
            best[0] = candidate[0];
            best[1] = candidate[1];
            return;
        }
        best[1] += candidate[1];
    }

    static long count_target(ArrayList<Long> arr, long target) {
        int lo = Collections.binarySearch(arr, target);
        if (lo < 0) lo = -lo - 1;
        int hi = Collections.binarySearch(arr, target + 1);
        if (hi < 0) hi = -hi - 1;
        return hi - lo;
    }

    static long compute_answer() {
        int max_pattern = 1 << (C + 1);
        long[] best = new long[]{1L << 60, 0};

        for (int pat = 0; pat < max_pattern; ++pat) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(pat);
            int a_here = C + 1 - b_here;
            long current = compute_delta(pat, R - 1, R - 1);

            long multiplier = get_multiplier(pat);
            ArrayList<Long> arr = PARTIAL[C + 1 - a_here];
            int pos = Collections.binarySearch(arr, -current);
            if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;

            if (pos < arr.size()) {
                long val = arr.get(pos);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + current)) {
                    long mult2 = count_target(arr, val);
                    long[] candidate = new long[]{val + current, multiplier * mult2};
                    update_optimal(best, candidate);
                }
            }

            if (pos > 0) {
                pos--;
                long val = arr.get(pos);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + current)) {
                    long mult2 = count_target(arr, val);
                    long[] candidate = new long[]{val + current, multiplier * mult2};
                    update_optimal(best, candidate);
                }
            }

            multiplier = 0;
            arr = PARTIAL_ZERO[C + 1 - a_here];
            pos = Collections.binarySearch(arr, -current);
            if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;

            if (pos < arr.size()) {
                long val = arr.get(pos);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + current)) {
                    long mult2 = count_target(arr, val);
                    long[] candidate = new long[]{val + current, multiplier * mult2};
                    update_optimal(best, candidate);
                }
            }

            if (pos > 0) {
                pos--;
                long val = arr.get(pos);
                if (best[0] >= Math.abs(val + current)) {
                    long mult2 = count_target(arr, val);
                    long[] candidate = new long[]{val + current, multiplier * mult2};
                    update_optimal(best, candidate);
                }
            }
        }

        return best[1];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line1 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        String line2 = br.readLine();
        INPUT = line2.toCharArray();
        
        // Adjust indexing to match original code (1-based)
        char[] newINPUT = new char[INPUT.length + 1];
        System.arraycopy(INPUT, 0, newINPUT, 1, INPUT.length);
        INPUT = newINPUT;
        
        TOTAL = 2 * (R + C);

        for (int i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
            PARTIAL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            PARTIAL_ZERO[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        precompute_comb();

        for (idx = 1; idx <= TOTAL; ++idx) {
            countA[idx] = countA[idx - 1] + (INPUT[idx] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            countB[idx] = countB[idx - 1] + (INPUT[idx] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        construct_tables();
        long result = compute_answer();
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
